name: Golden Pastures Of Trelawnyd
description:
12 fields including x2 new ones. As we know what has come off the land in recent event digs we have had there, if you haven’t been on with us and been following us on the group then all pics are up there.
There has been so many interesting finds upon these fields.
Including a gold noble & now half gold sovereign coin.
Dig fee - £20
16 & under free - with supervision.
Free lunch & drinks all day hot or cold & snacks, soups.
Toilet tent for all- but there is a McDonald’s 5mins always.
Parking will be on the fields suitable for bigger vehicles 4x4. And we have grass verge which is good for parking along too.
